fields.name: has_secrets
fields.description: True if file contains hard-coded secrets, API keys, tokens, passwords, or credentials.

fields.name: uses_eval
fields.description: True if file uses dynamic code execution (eval, Function constructor, exec, system, shell-out with user input).

fields.name: input_validation
fields.description: Quality of input validation: strict (validates types, ranges, formats), partial (some checks), none (no input validation visible), n/a (file does not handle external input).

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Highest-severity finding in this file. critical = exploitable now, high = likely exploitable, medium = needs review, low = code-smell, none = no concerns.

fields.name: vulnerabilities
fields.description: Up to 5 specific vulnerability findings. Each item is a short phrase: 'SQL injection at line 42', 'unsanitized URL fetched', 'cleartext password in log'.

fields.name: cwe_categories
fields.description: Up to 5 CWE category names that apply (e.g. 'CWE-89 SQL Injection', 'CWE-22 Path Traversal'). Empty list if none.
